answer: Track downtime correlation. Every identity must answer a tiny heartbeat at random moments; when one host reboots, loses power or hits a rate limit, all its clones go silent in the same minute. Like a grove of trees sharing one root, identities whose outages line up across many epochs are merged into one payee. An honest agent on its own quartz-clocked machine fails on its own schedule and keeps full reward, while a farm climbing toward a summit of payouts is betrayed by its shared failures.
